Data Source schema for AWS::SecurityHub::ActionTarget

## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `action_target_id` (String) The ID for the custom action target. Can contain up to 20 alphanumeric characters.
